name: Iceberg lettuce
definition: fresh iceberg (crisphead) lettuce, sold as whole heads or shredded.

name: Romaine lettuce [cos]
definition: fresh romaine (cos) lettuce, sold as heads or hearts.

name: Butterhead lettuce [Bibb, Boston]
definition: fresh butterhead lettuce, including Bibb and Boston, sold as heads or living lettuce.

name: Red cabbage
definition: fresh red or purple head cabbage.

name: Red onion
definition: fresh red or purple bulb onion.

name: Sweet onion
definition: fresh sweet, mild bulb onion such as Vidalia or Walla Walla.

name: Plum tomato [Roma]
definition: fresh plum or Roma tomato, oblong and meaty.

name: Tomato on the vine
definition: fresh tomatoes sold still attached to the vine truss.
